item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find independent 2024 evidence that Sisi personally admitted wrongdoing, disciplined senior allies for corruption, or credibly opened a transparent accountability process for abuse or self-dealing. The positive material is mostly official rhetoric, limited pardons, and narrow procedural easing.","evidence":[{"title":"Egypt: More than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"July 18, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/","summary":"Egyptian security forces detained 119 people after online calls for protests over price hikes and power cuts. This is strong evidence that the state punished peaceful criticism and helped normalize fear rather than ethical accountability.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Egypt: Halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"May 13, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty documented arrests of protesters, striking workers, and social-media critics, plus alleged abuse and weak investigation of complaints. This directly cuts against a ruler model of honesty, restraint, or respect for accountability.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Egypt: Civic Space Under Siege","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/egypt-civic-space-under-siege","summary":"HRW said Egypt drastically curtailed free expression and peaceful assembly ahead of the 2023 vote to stymie meaningful competition, which carried into the 2024 term. This is strong evidence against public trust and against a non-cynical governing style.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Egypt: Court Punishes Activists for Challenging al-Sisi","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"February 8, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/02/08/egypt-court-punishes-activists-challenging-al-sisi","summary":"A court sentenced Ahmed Tantawy and supporters for peaceful political activity tied to his challenge to Sisi and barred Tantawy from future elections. HRW framed this as retaliation that sent a message that no serious challenge to Sisi would be tolerated.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Egypt pardons prisoners on Police Day and January 25 Revolution","publisher":"Human Rights Studies - Egypt / SIS","date":"January 25, 2024","url":"https://hrightsstudies.sis.gov.eg/en/press/local/egypt-pardons-prisoners-on-Police-Day-and-January-25-Revolution/","summary":"The presidential pardon covered some prisoners convicted for political expression or political activity. This is a limited positive signal for reducing retaliation against some dissent-related prisoners, but it is episodic clemency, not a durable accountability mechanism.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"President El-Sisi directs the referral of the National Dialogue’s recommendations to the government","publisher":"SIS / Presidency","date":"August 21, 2024","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-el-sisi-directs-the-referral-of-the-national-dialogue-s-recommendations-to-the-government/","summary":"Sisi directed implementation of recommendations to reduce maximum pretrial detention, activate alternatives to detention, and compensate wrongful detention. This is the clearest official pro-restraint signal in 2024, but it remains narrow and official self-reporting.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Promoting Inclusive Human Capital Development and Building Resilience in Egypt through Cash Transfer Programs","publisher":"World Bank","date":"May 28, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs","summary":"The Takaful and Karama program was described as institutionalized, well-targeted, and supported by a grievance mechanism and dynamic registry; the benefit was increased in 2023/2024 to offset inflation. This is the best available positive evidence that some social policy was being run in a rule-based, not purely patronage, way.","question_ids":["7B.10"]},{"title":"Egypt: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/egypt/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says corruption is pervasive, Sisi controls the Administrative Control Authority, anti-corruption mechanisms are weak and ineffective, and security forces act with impunity. This is strong structural evidence that Sisi did not model ethical standards in a way that would reliably improve public trust.","question_ids":["7B.10"]}]}
